body.name: Published causally sufficient SCG adjustment certificate
body.construction:
Write \(H^{\to}=(V,E_{\to}(H))\), and let directed ancestors and descendants include the vertex itself.  For a directed graph \(G\), let \(\operatorname{Cyc}(v;G)\) be the set of simple directed cycles through \(v\), including a self-loop, and let \(\operatorname{Cyc}_{>1}(v;G)\) retain only cycles containing at least two distinct vertices.  Let \(\mathcal B_{\sigma}(X,Y;H^{\to})\) be the set of paths \(\pi=(v_1=X,\ldots,v_m=Y)\), \(m\ge 2\), with distinct vertices, consecutive vertices adjacent in \(H^{\to}\), first edge \(v_2\to X\), and no internal collider \(v_{j-1}\to v_j\leftarrow v_{j+1}\).  Thus these are exactly the \(\sigma\)-active back-door paths given the empty set in the directed summary convention of Assaad--Devijver--Gaussier--G\"ossler--Meynaoui.  Define
\[
 \begin{split}
 \mathsf O_1(H,X,Y,\gamma)
 &:=\bigl[\gamma\ne0\ \wedge\
 \operatorname{Cyc}_{>1}(X;H^{\to}\setminus\{Y\})\ne\varnothing\bigr],\\
 \mathsf O_2(H,X,Y,\gamma)
 &:=\Bigl[\exists\pi=(v_1=X,\ldots,v_m=Y)\in
 \mathcal B_{\sigma}(X,Y;H^{\to}):
 \{v_2,\ldots,v_{m-1}\}\subseteq
 \operatorname{Desc}_{H^{\to}}(X),\\
 &\hspace{35mm}\bigl(m>2\bigr)\ \vee\
 \bigl(m=2\wedge\gamma\ne1\bigr)\ \vee\
 \bigl(m=2\wedge\gamma=1\wedge
 \operatorname{Cyc}(Y;H^{\to}\setminus\{X\})\ne\varnothing\bigr)
 \Bigr],
 \end{split}
\]
and
\[
 \mathsf{Adj}_{\mathrm{ADGGM}}(H,X,Y,\gamma)
 :=[E_{\leftrightarrow}(H)=\varnothing]\wedge
 \Bigl[X\notin\operatorname{Anc}_{H^{\to}}(Y)\ \vee\
 \bigl(X\in\operatorname{Anc}_{H^{\to}}(Y)\wedge
 \neg\mathsf O_1(H,X,Y,\gamma)\wedge
 \neg\mathsf O_2(H,X,Y,\gamma)\bigr)\Bigr].
\]
Put \(D_X=\operatorname{Desc}_{H^{\to}}(X)\) and define the finite temporal adjustment set
\[
 \mathcal A_{\gamma}^{\mathrm{ADGGM}}(H,L,X)
 =\{Z_{-\gamma-\ell}:Z\in D_X,\ 1\le\ell\le L\}
 \cup
 \{Z_{-\gamma-\ell}:Z\in V\setminus D_X,\ 0\le\ell\le L\}.
\]
For a law \(P\) on \(\Omega_{\mathcal A}\), let
\(\mathfrak a_{\gamma}=\prod_{Z_s\in\mathcal A_{\gamma}^{\mathrm{ADGGM}}}\mathcal A_Z\), and define
\[
 F_{\mathrm{ADGGM}}(P;y,x)=
 \begin{cases}
 P\bigl(C_{\mathcal A}(\{(Y,0)\},y)\bigr),
 &X\notin\operatorname{Anc}_{H^{\to}}(Y),\\[1mm]
 \displaystyle
 \sum_{a\in\mathfrak a_{\gamma}}
 \frac{P\bigl(C_{\mathcal A}(\mathcal A_{\gamma}^{\mathrm{ADGGM}}\cup
 \{(X,-\gamma),(Y,0)\},(a,x,y))\bigr)
 P\bigl(C_{\mathcal A}(\mathcal A_{\gamma}^{\mathrm{ADGGM}},a)\bigr)}
 {P\bigl(C_{\mathcal A}(\mathcal A_{\gamma}^{\mathrm{ADGGM}}\cup
 \{(X,-\gamma)\},(a,x))\bigr)},
 &X\in\operatorname{Anc}_{H^{\to}}(Y).
 \end{cases}
\]
The empty-cylinder convention is
\(C_{\mathcal A}(\varnothing,\varnothing)=\Omega_{\mathcal A}\).
